digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge — multi-project inbound/outbound sync
propositions: One shared ticket store must coordinate N repos and N tracker projects, with each ticket recording its source project and member repos, stored in .bridge_state/projects.json alongside bindings.json to prevent each repo from diffing other projects' tickets as remote deletions.

The inbound fetcher must issue one JQL pair per configured project and merge enrichment data (parent/comment/issuelink maps) from all projects into a shared snapshot, with per-project truncation ceilings.
Each ticket has a tri-state project field (absent=legacy, empty=never-sync, explicit=sync-to-that-project) seeded by idempotent ensure from the store mapping with zero event writes.

Outbound create must use the ticket's explicit project if set, falling back to Backend.project default; outbound update/delete must proceed if the target is in the configured project set, else raise CrossProjectTargetError.

A store holding >1 project must carry multi-project-bridge in .store-compat.json required_capabilities; older binaries lacking that capability must refuse writes to such stores while single-project stores remain writable.
Pre-feature stores must resolve to legacy defaults with byte-identical event counts before/after migration sweep, ensuring backward compatibility without per-ticket EDIT events.
